title: Provisioning Composer: EKS control-plane Terraform module for safe upgrades and orchestration
creator: Priya Patel
description: Design and implement a composable Terraform module (provisioning-composer) to provision and manage the Redwood Private control plane (EKS) in customer VPCs. The module must support: - idempotent create/update flows for control plane resources (EKS cluster, control-plane roles, control-plane node groups if used by bootstrapper) - safe, observable rolling upgrades with preflight validations, canary patches, and automatic rollback triggers - pluggable KMS/CMK bindings for cross-account encryption and SRE-managed grants - lifecycle hooks for operator-driven reconciliations and post-upgrade health probes - integration points for Redwood Console observability (tracing, metrics, token-level audit links) This ticket covers module API design, core implementation of the upgrade orchestration runner (Terraform-driven step sequencing), preflight validations, health-check lambdas/probers, and a test harness that exercises the canary + rollback path on a disposable account.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module follows composer pattern: separates bootstrap, control-plane, and post-provision hooks
Upgrades can be executed as 'plan -> canary -> rollout' with explicit step IDs and automated rollback on failures
Preflight validations run and block plan/apply when critical checks fail (network NAT, control plane IAM roles, KMS access)
Health probes (control plane API, kube-apiserver latency, nodegroup readiness) are exposed via metrics and can be consumed by Console
Automated test harness validates canary path by performing a staged Kubernetes minor version upgrade in a disposable account
Module is idempotent across repeated applies and documents required provider versions and providers configuration
Documentation includes example usage for cross-account KMS, private endpoint-only clusters, and immutable-tag strategy for upgrade orchestration
tasks: Write module API schema (inputs/outputs) and examples for 'bootstrap', 'cluster', 'post_provision' blocks
Implement preflight validator scripts (terraform external + small Go binary for network/IAM checks)
Implement upgrade orchestrator using a plan-token pattern to sequence canary then rollout steps
Add Lambda-based health prober that emits metrics to CloudWatch/OpenTelemetry and returns structured status
Integrate Sentry/Console logs links in post-provision hooks
Create test harness infra for disposable canary upgrades (account-anchored), add CI job
Write runbook and rollback playbook for on-call SRE
Publish module to internal Terraform registry and add usage example in infra docs
comments: 2025-03-05 Priya Patel: Initial ticket created after architectural spike with Research. Key requirement: avoid long-lived drift-prone upgrade scripts; prefer declarative, idempotent operations with an orchestration layer.

2025-03-06 Evan Chen: Implementing preflight validator prototype. Found a tricky edge-case when clusters use private API endpoint + transit gateway. Need to add NAT Egress checks and documented workaround.
2025-03-08 Security (Marta Velez): Reviewed KMS pattern. We need to ensure CMK grants are time-bounded in the canary account and that grandparent-account roles are not assumed implicitly.

2025-03-10 SRE (Jordan Miles): Requested a clear metric for 'control-plane-upgrade-progress' and a fatal probe that flips iff kube-apiserver median latency > 2s for 5 minutes during upgrade. Added to acceptance criteria.
2025-03-12 Evan Chen: Pushed first working module prototype and a CI job in a feature branch. Opening a PR tomorrow for initial review; still wiring the rollback signal into the controller lambda.
